item.title: GhostAction Hacking Wave Fizzles, But Attackers Lurk on in GitHub
item.description: The supply chain attack campaign's shift toward developer endpoints and cloud access signals what could be next for the cybercrime outfit.

item.title: Attacker Relentlessly Scans for Credentials by Impersonating AI Bots
item.description: The threat actor lurked behind bots posing as agents from OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and others to find exposed data.

item.title: External Teams Chats Anchor 15-Minute Malware Delivery
item.description: Mail bombing is getting a new look with a wide-scale, ongoing social engineering campaign that might be tied to the Black Basta ransomware gang.

item.title: State Bank of India Suffers a Customer PII Data Leak
item.description: Relatively small data breaches in India can turn quite serious, thanks to a sophisticated underground market for trading PII.

item.title: Tech Giants Block eMudhra Certificates Tied to 8 Compromised Keys
item.description: Google, Mozilla, Apple, the Go project and others moved swiftly to block the affected certificates from the Indian CA, though it's unclear how the keys were compromised.

item.title: Cybersecurity Awareness Month: "Securing the Next 250" & Beyond
item.description: This Cybersecurity Awareness Month's theme, "Securing the Next 250," asks us to look beyond vulnerabilities and consider what will make our digital systems resilient for generations.
